data.description: A bright orange rain cape worn by at least two figures in the story. First appears as a silhouette at the ferry ticket office window, worn by an unidentified courier. Later, an old man wearing an orange rain cape is seen at the ferry pier by the gangway. The cape is visible in foggy conditions and serves as a distinctive visual marker for characters involved in the envelope and locker exchange.
data.name: Orange Rain Cape
data.narrative_significance: The orange rain cape is worn by mysterious figures facilitating a covert exchange involving envelope 17, a brass locker key, and a metal cash box. It marks the presence of intermediaries in a transaction that appears significant to the plot, though their identities and full roles remain obscured. The cape's distinctive color makes it a visual identifier in the fog-shrouded setting.
